clips.title: The story
paras: Pacify the Centaur is a retaliatory hunting mission issued by Cliffwatcher Longhorn atop Freewind Post. Charged with clearing the threat gathering beneath the canyon spires, Horde adventurers strike deep into the Galak centaur encampments of Splithoof Crag.

Perched upon its precarious desert mesa, Freewind Post grants the tauren a commanding vantage over the canyon floor of Thousand Needles. However, that high ground offers little peace when hostile enemies mass directly beneath the ropes and elevators. The Galak centaur have established a sprawling war camp nestled directly north along the canyon wall at Splithoof Crag, directly menacing supply lines and tauren movement through the needles.

To counter the growing danger, Cliffwatcher Longhorn sends capable Horde travelers to thin the Galak ranks through unsparing violence. Rather than merely defending the access lifts, the tauren believe the only way to safeguard Freewind Post is to break the centaur vanguard in their own camp. Taking down their scouts, beast-wranglers, and windchaser mystics is meant to blunt any concerted assault on the post before it can begin.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend, I entreat you to hunt these centaur down. They shall feel the wrath of our revenge. Attack the centaur camp to the north of Freewind Post! Let wrath guide your hand!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Come now friend, I know you haven't killed your share yet. Hunt them down, and I shall give you a reward for my gratitude.

clips.title: Completion
paras: For my gratitude, this is for you, friend.
